overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, focused social media presence across professional and decentralized networks (LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon), boasting a total audience of 3,580 followers. Content primarily centers around computational social science research, software releases, grant announcements, and academic opportunities, generating consistently high engagement across platforms.

contentThemes.description: Research and methodologies focusing on detecting coordinated link sharing, information operations, and campaign detection.
Announcements related to open-source software updates and computational methods like CooRnet.
Postings regarding grant wins, postdoctoral job openings, and student research opportunities.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on Mastodon and Bluesky to leverage higher engagement rates relative to follower count.
Include direct links and multimedia (e.g., paper PDFs, tool screenshots) in announcements to increase click-through rates.
Cross-post academic recruitment calls on all platforms simultaneously to maximize applicant reach.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky yields the highest relative engagement rate (~6.14%), particularly driven by paper publications and PhD opportunities that stimulate retweets/reposts.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon shows strong interest in technical tool releases (CooRnet v2.0) and methodological debates, appealing to a tech-savvy research niche.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn has the largest audience base (1,850 followers) and drives the highest raw engagement on major milestones like research grant wins and hiring announcements.
